title: Request Access
intro_description: CUNY faculty, staff, and students can apply here for access to the Lab's tools, or ask for help with an existing account. One application covers the chat sandbox, API keys, and the studios.
features: The chat sandbox for conversations with AI models
API keys you create and manage for the Lab's model endpoint
Agent Studio and Site Studio for research and publishing work
Transcription, image description, and document OCR tools
A monthly spending limit on model use, shown on your Model Access page

individual.label: My own access
individual.description: A Lab account of your own, for coursework, research, or teaching.

class.label: A class I'm teaching or organizing
class.description: Access for everyone in your course. You apply once; after approval you share an invitation link and students use it to join.

application_kind.class_note: One application covers the whole class. You do not need existing Lab access to apply, and your students join through the invitation link you share after approval.

email.label: Verified CUNY Email
email.placeholder: Sign in with CUNY Login to load your verified email

campus.label: CUNY College/Campus
campus.placeholder: e.g., Graduate Center, Hunter College, Baruch

intended_use.label: Intended Use or Support Request
intended_use.placeholder: Describe how you plan to use CAIL services, or tell us what help you need.

ends_on.label: End Date
ends_on.help: The last day participants need access.

privacy_note: The Lab stores this information to review your request, manage access, and contact you about CAIL services.

next_steps.title: Review
next_steps.description: The Lab reviews the application and checks the information provided.

next_steps.title: Decision
next_steps.description: The Lab approves the request, declines it, or follows up for more information.

next_steps.title: Invitation
next_steps.description: After a class is approved, its organizers sign in with CUNY Login and share an invitation link. Students use the link to claim a spot.

next_steps.title: Access
next_steps.description_html: Individual members and class participants use the same tools through the Tools page. Class access runs for the approved course dates.

questions_text: Have questions about access or the platform?
questions_link_text: Contact the CUNY AI Lab Team →

student_note.heading: Taking a class that uses the Lab?
student_note.text: Your instructor shares an invitation link with the class. Open that link, sign in with CUNY Login, and claim your place. If you need the link, ask your instructor.
